thread:
olivia park: Idea: add a compact 'simulate + replay' workflow in the console for fallback policies. quick sanity-check before rollout.

max rosen: yes. simulate should accept an input blob + optional seed so results are deterministic. show a human-friendly explanation.

nina ko: replay is key: re-run a time window of recorded (anonymized) requests against a candidate policy and return deltas (expected fallback_rate, errors). block auto-deploy if delta > threshold.

olivia park: UI: small simulate panel under editor, 'record simulation' toggle, and replay wizard that accepts ts range + sample size. show histogram and top-affected tenants.

max rosen: API hooks: POST /policies/{id}/simulate, POST /policies/{id}/replay. replay must be RBAC gated and operate on redacted blobs. add ?dry_run=true for both.

nina ko: telemetry: emit simulated_decisions, replay_jobs_count, replay_delta_fallback. separate from live metrics. retention defaults: 30d for simulated, 90d for live audit.

olivia park: safety: deterministic seed + stable predicate semantics. bump schema when predicate language changes. include an explainability modal per audit row (matched triggers, sample-roll, selected action).

deploy-bot: rollout started: policy-sim v1 -> canary 3%

max rosen: small demo harness would speed QA. can be a node app that emits synthetic qps/error metrics.

nina ko: also add a 'pause on spike' guard: optional auto-pause if fallback_rate exceeds X for Y minutes. default: notify + require manual approval.

olivia park: great. i'll write a quick RFC and attach mockups. tagging @max @nina for review.

deploy-bot: canary healthy -> promoted to 25%

max rosen: thanks all — will help wire the simulate endpoint in staging.
